implementation.summary: D51 adds isolated Kafka topics and a candidate-bound live journey for a record just below 1 MiB, a micro-batch totaling 8,000,000 bytes, and a rejected micro-batch totaling 9,000,000 bytes. Streaming runtime production code is unchanged.

qualification.result: D51 expands P11 evidence without qualifying the family or closing a release gate

limitations: D51 covers byte-boundary acceptance/rejection on real Kafka/Redpanda but does not prove indefinite backpressure, multi-broker recovery, worker/provider breadth or the complete P11 journey.
No release gate closes and release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
The candidate live run is filtered; route-wide audit, full suite, security scans, Trivy and license decisions were not rerun.
